note: The equipe desktop app (crates/desktop) as it is. It has no URL, so `equipe design flows shoot` can't reach it: every picture is the real app built with `--features snapshot`, attached to the fake daemon (crates/desktop/examples/fake_daemon.rs) and driven by a snapshot script — see design/flows/shoot-desktop.py, which also writes this file. Widths are the window's in points, 1x: 1200 (as it opens) and 760 (the narrowest it allows, so every state's 760 picture is the narrow window). English UI unless a state names a language; `long` states are German. Each run has a throwaway home with sample SSH hosts and a stand-in `tailscale` (design/flows/fixtures/), so nothing of this Mac's own is pictured. No flow has a `walk` (`flows record` plays a walk in a browser, which can't drive the app): a recorded flow has a `record_command`, design/flows/record-desktop.py, which steps the same snapshot build through it and writes the video with its screen marks — record with `--widths 1200,760`.
